title: Chile con Queso
summary: A silky, molten cheese dip with golden onion, smoky chipotle, tomato and green chilli, made smooth with evaporated milk and served hot with tortilla chips.
equipment: 20 cm cast-iron frying pan or small flameproof serving dish

ingredients.item: chipotle chillies in adobo, finely chopped
green chilli (such as jalapeño), seeded and finely diced

steps.title: Cook the base
steps.text: Heat the oil in the saucepan over medium-high heat and cook the onion for 5-6 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden at the edges. Add the chipotle and garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant, then the drained tomatoes and green chilli for 2 minutes until hot and most of the liquid has gone. Cooking off the tomato juice now stops it thinning the cheese sauce later.

steps.title: Keep it warm
steps.text: Scrape the base into the cast-iron pan and set it over the lowest heat. Having it ready and hot means the finished dip arrives at the table steaming.

steps.title: Dust the cheese
steps.text: Toss both grated cheeses with the cornflour in a bowl until every shred is coated. The starch sits between the proteins and fat as they melt, which keeps the sauce from turning stringy or oily.

steps.title: Melt gently
steps.text: Wipe out the saucepan, add the evaporated milk and bring it to a bare simmer over medium-low heat. Off the heat, add the cheese a handful at a time, stirring until each addition melts, then return to low heat for 1-2 minutes until completely smooth and glossy, about 75 °C. Evaporated milk's concentrated proteins help hold the emulsion, but boiling would still make it grainy.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.text: Pour the cheese sauce over the tomato and chilli base and fold through just once or twice, so the red and green pieces stay visible. Serve at once, hot, with the tortilla chips tucked around the pan.

tips: Grate the cheese yourself; pre-shredded cheese is coated in anti-caking powders that can make the dip gritty.
The most common mistake is overheating, which splits the sauce; keep the heat low once the cheese goes in.
Chipotle heat varies a lot between brands, so start with 1 tsp if you are unsure and add more at the base stage.
If the dip thickens as it sits, loosen it over low heat with 1-2 tbsp milk.
storage: Cool and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Reheat gently over low heat, stirring and adding a splash of milk, until piping hot.
